source_mass_rule: Voronoi cells on original RGB-polyline arclength, using retained ORIGINAL node arclength positions; midpoint boundaries conserve each original visible fragment support exactly.
loss_rule: Combine all authenticated fragments of one actual-exposure physical curve before sum-to-one integration; each original UV paired residual component receives the same point mass. Original working sigma and declared original prior sampling factor remain separate.
